tests.name: test_add_product_to_cart
tests.title: Adding a product to the cart updates the cart quantity and total

steps.note: a stable path; the product is reached by clicking
the first card — chain .first, this selector matches every product

expected: Cart total reflects the product price

meta.splitReason: One test per plan — the shape that has generated cleanly on the first attempt all day.
meta.note: The cart page also exposes [data-test="product-title"], [data-test="product-quantity"], [data-test="product-price"], [data-test="line-price"], [data-test="cart-total"]. A plan that wants to assert on line-price or cart-total has to name them in its own steps: the generator only allows selectors the plan sanctioned, and this plan originally asserted on totals it never listed.
